name: Li P'in
bio: Li P'in was a T'ang poet who took his degree at the government examinations in AD 854. His poem here is the homecomer who dares not ask for news of his family.
The poem here is Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu's versions in The Jade Mountain (1929), given with the poet's name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: Crossing the Han River
poems.author: Li P'in
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
Away from home, I was longing for news
Winter after winter, spring after spring.
Now, nearing my village, meeting people,
I dare not ask a single question.
